sections.title: Scholarship and Personal Development III
sections.description: In this course, faculty participants will develop and expand upon high-level personal competencies foundational to success in faculty appointments. Focus will be on interpersonal skills critical to negotiation and crucial conversations, and strategic career planning. Prerequisite: Faculty interested in enrolling in ACFD 6020, Scholarship and Personal Development III will first need to be admitted to the Academic Foundations Certificate program, and complete ACFD 6000, Scholarship and Professional Development I, and ACFD 6010, Scholarship and Personal Development II. Program prerequisites include (but are not limited to) a current, full time faculty appointment at an accredited university. Participation in this program requires prior approval from faculty chair/chief as appropriate
